lane: magnetic-edge ridge, catalogue-free generation, catalogue-proximity gate only
hypothesis: Thinning the same catalogue-free magnetic ridge to one dot per 300 m kernel width (strongest-edge-first) removes redundant mass; its pooled DTI on withheld catalogue segments then exceeds matched random placement.

layers_used.catalogue_dependence: none for ridge generation; catalogue enters only via the 300 m gate

physical_signature: local maxima of total horizontal magnetic gradient across an edge, i.e. a non-maximum-suppressed ridge

parameters.nms: THD >= THD at +/-1 px along the RTP gradient direction (nearest neighbour)
parameters.emission: src/gemsdoe54/emission.py::emit_spaced_dots, priority = official tmi_hg band, after catalogue gate

holdout_design.name: segment hide-and-recover
holdout_design.unit: 8-connected catalogue components merged with a 3 px (300 m) Euclidean collar (scripts via gemsdoe54.holdout.segment_blocks)
holdout_design.fold_assignment: buffered groups shuffled per split, then greedily assigned to the fold with the fewest withheld positives
holdout_design.visible_catalogue: catalogue cells outside the withheld fold's buffered groups
holdout_design.prediction_mask: candidate cells within 300 m of the visible catalogue are removed; visible cells are masked pixel-exactly
holdout_design.scoring: per fold: official distance-weighted Tversky (scripts/gems_metric.py) against that fold's withheld cells; DTI pooled by summing TP_w, FP_w, FN_w over folds, then DTI = TP/(TP+0.2FP+0.8FN)

controls.matched_random_null: same dot count per fold, drawn uniformly from valid cells outside the 300 m visible-catalogue zone
controls.placebo_shift: same spaced emission applied to the ridge map rolled by (1234, -567) px

leakage_canary.rule: single feature AUC > 0.90 against the withheld truth means leakage until proven otherwise
leakage_canary.features: all 19 bands (sentinel cells excluded), distance-to-visible-catalogue, candidate indicator

promote_eligible_only_if: paired split-level 95% CI of (candidate - matched random null) lies entirely above 0
paired split-level 95% CI of (candidate - placebo) lies entirely above 0
decision_rule.otherwise: negative result; no submission slot is recommended
decision_rule.note: E2 is exploratory: a pass is a lead for an independent replication, not promotion evidence.

scope_limits: The holdout target is CATALOGUED faults, not the expert-labelled NEW faults that the competition scores. Recovering withheld catalogue segments is evidence about a physical feature-to-fault link, not proof of new-fault discovery.
A HOLDOUT-DTI here is not a leaderboard score and not ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.
The official feature file is owner-mirrored; byte integrity matches owner pins, organizer origin not authenticated.
motivation: Disclosure: this design was chosen AFTER E1's split-0 decomposition showed that dense one-pixel ridge lines waste credit (TP_w takes a per-truth-cell maximum, so redundant dots add mass without credit). The spacing (one dot per 300 m kernel width) is the existing rule 2 of src/gemsdoe54/emission.py, fixed a priori from the metric geometry, not fitted to E2 outcomes. It uses the SAME 16 splits as E1, so E2 is exploratory and is NOT an independent confirmation of E1.

changes: splits reduced from 16 to 4: the candidate's pooled DTI is invariant to the random partition (identical to 5 decimals), so more splits add no information about the candidate and only the null varies
uncertainty changed from split-to-split paired t to an exact leave-one-segment-group-out jackknife (913 units) on the first partition; split-to-split spread is reported only for transparency
a built-in cross-check asserts that the fast group counts equal the official metric for every fold
amendments.reason: E1 v1 was started and stopped after 4 splits (console log retained below as a NON-RECEIPT). Its split-level CI would have been invalid: identical candidate scores across splits imply near-zero split variance, which would overstate precision. The unit of independent evidence is the buffered segment group.
amendments.e1_v1_killed_by: manual stop after observing invariance; the earlier E1 attempt was also SIGKILLed (likely memory pressure while a diagnostic ran concurrently)
amendments.note: same amendment as E1, applied before E2 was run
